instruction.text: Look at the photo. What is the main idea?

hint.text: The main idea is the most important message.

atoms.b: Pierre has been searching for the rarest of all books for many years. It is said that no one can finish reading it because the story is always changing. He is sailing towards the secret Island of Pages. He hopes to find the book there.

b: ++Pierre is sailing to an island to find the rarest of all books.
Pierre would like to visit the Island of Pages for his holidays.

atoms.b: Chongo bakes a cake and invites Falurna over for tea. Chongo asks Falurna if she would like to help him. Falurna says yes and is very excited to start working on Furcumber Farm!
